study_design.timing: Median of two timings within each state/method; reported percentiles summarize 432 state medians. V3 and V4 were timed in separate runs.
study_design.refinement: Incremental rejection was specified after observing V3 and before running V4. A backup terminates on the first sampled explicit constraint violation; the Euler update and complete-witness criterion remain unchanged.
study_design.comparison: Same frozen maps, 432 states, seven methods, two repeats and 3,600/10,800-step hard limits. A separate replay of the same 480 closed-loop tasks verifies implementation equivalence and is not counted as additional independent evidence.
study_design.bootstrap: 10,000 paired resamples of 24 map clusters, seed 12345; each map retains all its states. Percentile intervals describe this generated suite.
study_design.rejection_counts: V4 classifies the first observed violation; V3 classifies after a complete rollout. Per-reason rejection counts have different meanings and are not compared.
study_design.budget: Equal hard integration limits do not imply equal consumed work. Unfinished rollouts never count as verified.

implementation_equivalence.numeric_comparison: exact equality of parsed CSV numeric values; no tolerance
implementation_equivalence.interpretation: Duplicate executions of the original 480 tasks verify implementation equivalence; they are not additional independent scenarios and are not pooled with V3 outcomes.
